prompt: Who set the Guinness World Record by building the largest Nerf gun, measuring 3.81 meters (12 feet 6 inches), on October 15, 2021?
answer: Michael Pick of Huntsville, Alabama, set the Guinness World Record for building the largest Nerf gun, measuring 3.81 meters (12 feet 6 inches), on October 15, 2021.
